//: There was no tsconfig.json in this project at all, which meant `astro check`
had never run and nothing verified ~16,000 lines of TypeScript — every
component's frontmatter, the whole of src/data, and the three-locale copy
contract. The code was WRITTEN as though checked: 60 interfaces, every
component with a typed Props, `// @ts-check` at the top of astro.config.mjs.
`astro/tsconfigs/strict` is Astro's own preset. It is deliberately not
`strictest`, which adds noUncheckedIndexedAccess — correct in principle, but
this codebase indexes keyed records constantly (galleryArt[id],
LISTINGS[number], keyPlans[`${beds}-${level}`]) and turning it on would
bury a real first signal under hundreds of mechanical ones. Those lookups
are a genuine weakness the audit flagged; the fix is to make them throw on
a miss, not to make the compiler shout about every one.
`.astro/types.d.ts` must be included explicitly. Astro generates it on every
`astro sync`/`astro build`, and without it in `include` there are no ambient
types for image imports, `astro:content`, or import.meta.env — which is
exactly the noise a first run produces.
